_meta: Per-rerity render rules extracted from UILotteryPromotion prefab. Source: prefab_out/UILotteryPromotion.json TextMeshProUGUI components + RectTransform anchors, grouped by their rerity<N> ancestor.

panels._note: Per-panel RectTransform: anchoredPosition in CANVAS pixels (anchorMin/Max=0.5,0.5 pivot=0.5,0.5), sizeDelta in pixels. The panels are LARGER than the canvas and overflow — the CanvasGroup parent (rerity container) clips them.

simpletween._source: parse_simpletween.py — manual byte-decode of the 8 SimpleTweenTMPSage MonoBehaviours on UILotteryPromotion (UnityPy TypeTree fails on this subclassed MonoBehaviour). Values in SECONDS.
simpletween._note: limitDuration=0 (no cap), isOnlyAlpha=false, isRandom=false on all. The animationCurve is a linear 0→1 (keys [0,0]→[1,1], slopes 1).

panel_text_per_rerity._note: TextMeshProUGUI m_text strings from each rerity<N>.BackText/MiddleText/FrontText.<Back/Middle/Front><N>. Identical across rerity sub-trees in the prefab.
